summary: Frontend-only Phase 2C regression testing completed for sign-in, contacts route stability, and new contact-qr flow. Sign-in screen is stable, sign-in button opens external auth popup, /contacts safely redirects unauthenticated users to sign-in, and /contact-qr renders with tab switching (My QR <-> Scan QR) without frontend crash.

ui_bugs.issue: When unauthenticated, /contact-qr?mode=show renders the screen but stays in loading state (spinner) with no fallback message or auth redirect; my-qr-card never appears.
Some tap targets appear below the recommended 44x44 mobile minimum (e.g., add/reject icon buttons), increasing miss-tap risk.

integration_issues.issue: Route is reachable and stable, but authenticated user data dependency is unresolved in show mode for signed-out state, resulting in non-terminal loading UX.

action_items: Add explicit unauth behavior on /contact-qr (redirect to sign-in or show clear signed-out fallback) instead of indefinite loader in My QR mode.
Increase small icon-only touch targets in contacts actions to >=44x44 for mobile ergonomics.
Track repeated Expo warnings seen during run (expo-av deprecation, shadow* deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation) and plan cleanup before SDK upgrades.
critical_code_review_comments: contact-qr.tsx currently depends on me?._id to build QR payload but does not handle signed-out state in show mode, causing spinner-only UI.
contacts.tsx includes compact icon action controls that likely undercut 44x44 touch-target guidance on mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file is present and was read before auth checks. Deterministic full OIDC completion remains third-party-dependent, but sign-in click opens auth popup in this run. Core requested checks passed except unauthenticated My QR fallback behavior.
rca_of_issue: Repro (unauth My QR): open /contact-qr?mode=show in signed-out session -> contact-qr-screen renders and tabs switch works -> My QR stays loader because payload requires current user data (me?._id) and no signed-out fallback/redirect path exists.
